question: How should the six ritual limbs be formed using the seed syllable?
premises: vījena specifies seed syllable as instrument
ṣaḍdīrghabhājā qualifies it with six long forms
inference: One should form the six limbs in sequence with the seed syllable endowed with six long vowels.
uncertainties: Exact phonetic form of the seed syllable is not specified here.
plain_english: One should form the six limbs in sixfold sequence using the seed syllable endowed with six long vowels.
